about: Official household emergency-preparedness guidance in the EU and EEA, as data for Vorrat presets. See README.md. Only 'verified' entries may feed numbers into the app.

status_values.verified: Numbers and items read from the official source (or an official copy of it) on the compiled date.
status_values.partial: Source read, but the full list was not available; use only what is listed.
status_values.unverified: Authority and link only; nothing usable read yet. Do not use for targets.

basis_note: per_person_day: a daily amount, multiply by people and days. per_person, per_adult, per_child, per_baby, per_pet: a total for the source's own recommended period (its 'days'), not per day. per_household: one set for the home. null: the source gives no number or scale. applies_to lists the profile triggers that switch an item on; empty means everyone. Medicine items stay generic: never name a drug or dose beyond what the source says.

sources.name: European Union
sources.days_note: Key action 14: 'Develop guidelines to reach a population self-sufficiency of minimum 72 hours'.
sources.note: The strategy is a target for Member States, not a household checklist. It announces EU guidelines for Member States on reaching 72 hours (storage of essential supplies, crisis planning, shelter) and an EU platform with information for citizens; none had been published when this was compiled.

sources.water_note: Seven 1.5 L bottles 'pro Person und Haushalt' (about 10.5 L a week); body needs at least 1.5 L a day. 2012 brochure: 21 L of drinks per person for 14 days.

sources.note: zivilschutz.at blocked automated reading; figures come from the association's regional guide (Steiermark) and its 2012 brochure.
